form.name: Option Name
form.required_caution: Marking this option as required means every variant of this product must supply a value for it. If this option has no values yet, variants can't be saved until you add some.
form.name_info: Shown to customers picking this option (e.g., "Color", "Size").
form.code_info: Machine-friendly slug used in APIs and URLs. Lowercase, no spaces.
form.data_type_info: Text/Number/Color lists use predefined values. Free Text and Free Number accept arbitrary input.
form.min_value_info: Smallest numeric value accepted. Only applies to numeric data types.
form.max_value_info: Largest numeric value accepted. Only applies to numeric data types.
form.sort_order_info: Lower numbers appear first when options are listed.
form.active_info: Inactive options are hidden from new variants but preserved on existing rows.
form.description_info: Optional internal description. Up to 500 characters.

empty.title: No Options
empty.message: No product options have been added yet.
empty.value_message: No values have been added to this option yet.

confirm.delete_option: Are you sure you want to delete this option? All associated values will also be removed.
confirm.delete_value: Are you sure you want to delete this value?
